title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta28

## Navigation, cycle and Map API stabilization

### Gate and navigation safety

- Give MQTT work-target and partition-target fields their own receive timestamps. A fresh pose no longer makes an older cached target look fresh, and stale target fields are excluded from gate intent while remaining visible in diagnostics.
- Consolidate post-fallback target and gate arbitration into one `navigation_intent` layer. The beta27 same-zone protection now requires fresh physical-zone evidence, refuses to clear an in-channel or arrival-delay latch, stops on unknown/stale position, and is cancelled by a failed or replacement command.
- Keep the same-zone hand-over guard bounded to 120 seconds while preserving real cross-zone travel.
- Require strictly increasing private-cloud report timestamps for risky gate-clear/arrival confirmation. Duplicate and out-of-order reports neither advance nor erase an earlier confirmation.
- Reject non-finite private-cloud timestamps and timestamps more than 30 seconds in the future instead of treating them as fresh gate evidence.
- Add target-field age/freshness/stale-field diagnostics to the navigation snapshot.

### Mowing-cycle correctness

- Separate the zones used to close an old active task from the zones explicitly reset by a new mowing command. A new command for zone B can no longer incorrectly mark old active zone A as B's new cycle boundary.
- Record `closed_zone_ids`, `requested_zone_ids`, and reset `zone_ids` independently in cycle diagnostics.
- Extend current-cycle render invalidation to active reset-zone entry, in-session zone boundaries, pending reset zones, and completed-session metadata.
- Build current-cycle source geometry and SVG archives outside Home Assistant's event loop and publish a deterministic revision covering every rendering input.

### History and Map API performance

- Avoid deep-copying cached timestamped point arrays when callers request session metadata only.
- Add a backward-compatible phased Map API: the existing response remains unchanged by default, while new cards may request the base map with `include_current_cycle=0` and fetch a compact `current_cycle_only=1` artifact independently.
- Preserve the exact retained history as the source of truth; no trail points or sessions are discarded by these optimizations.

### Architecture and regression coverage

- Replace the beta27-only gate patch in production wiring with cohesive `navigation_intent`, `history_performance`, and `map_api_performance` components.
- Add permanent, version-independent regression tests for stale MQTT targets, future/non-finite cloud timestamps, duplicate/out-of-order cloud confirmations, same-zone gate cancellation boundaries, A-to-B cycle reset ownership, runtime ordering, point-light history reads, and phased Map API behavior.

### Field-test expectations

- A one-zone command for the mower's fresh current physical zone must not leave or recreate an old opposite-zone pre-transit gate latch.
- Stale/unknown position or an already active mapped-channel crossing must remain fail-safe and must not be reclassified as a completed same-zone hand-over.
- Starting zone 37 after an unfinished zone 36 task must close 36's old session but reset only zone 37's current-cycle display.
- Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta16 can show the base map before the backend current-cycle artifact finishes loading.
